## Summary

<!-- What does this PR change, and why? Link any related issue (e.g. Closes #123). -->

## Type of change

- [ ] `feat` — new functionality
- [ ] `fix` — bug fix
- [ ] `refactor` — no behaviour change
- [ ] `docs` / `test` / `chore`

## Checklist

- [ ] PR title follows Conventional Commits (`type(scope): description`)
- [ ] `npm run verify` passes (lint + build + coverage ≥ 80%)
- [ ] Tests added/updated for the change — success **and** failure paths
- [ ] Relevant `AGENTS.md` updated for any architecture / route / behaviour change
- [ ] Every new env var is documented in `.env.example`
- [ ] No secrets, PII, or personal machine paths committed
- [ ] Security defaults left intact (deny-by-default auth, CORS/credentials, rate limiting, fail-closed config)
